component.name: 3D Soundscape Studio
component.summary: 3D Spatial Ambient Soundscape Studio & Binaural Player

description.p: 3D Soundscape Studio is a professional digital audio workstation and 3D spatial soundscape generator featuring real-time polar positioning, multi-channel HRTF binaural audio rendering, and organic sound textures.

ul.li: Interactive 3D spatial soundstage with real-time polar drag-and-drop
Multi-speaker spatial layouts (Stereo, Binaural HRTF, Quadraphonic, 5.1, 7.1, 7.1.4 Dolby Atmos)
Autonomous listener path automation with real-world speeds (0.1 to 30 m/s)
Automated sound scraper integrating the Ambient-Mixer public library
Rich tactile Organic Zen interface with natural materials and themes
High-quality lossless audio export in WAV, FLAC, MP3, and OGG formats

description.p: Initial release of 3D Soundscape Studio with Organic Zen theme, 3D polar positioning, and multi-channel HRTF binaural engine.
